summary: Unit tests for new resource modules must cover all states with config combinations, error cases, and check changed and commands in every test; they run in Zuul on the latest supported Python.
questions: What unit tests are required for a resource module?
What should every resource module unit test assert?

answer_card.title: Resource module unit test requirements
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Tests for every state with all config value combinations.
2. Negative tests for error conditions.
3. Check `changed` and `commands` in every test.

They run in Zuul on the latest Python the CI supports.
